modifiers.value: Additional Copy Costs is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Additional Copy Costs entries.

selectionEntries.comment: ADDITIONAL COPY COSTS REV11 / GS17. Permanent required accounting entry. The single parent now exposes Troops and Other accounting children. Light Troupe, Dark Troupe, and Twilight Troupe use independent 4 / 6 / 8 Troop allowances, counted by their shared library unit IDs. Skyweaver, Voidweaver, and Starweaver preserve the existing 1 / 2 / 3 Other arithmetic exactly. No generated, free, or otherwise exempt Troop unit exists in this catalogue/library pair. The parent retains automatic insertion, Required Additional Copy Costs Configuration, and duplicate-entry validation.

selectionEntries.name: Troops
selectionEntries.comment: TROOP COPY-COST LEDGER. Light Troupe, Dark Troupe, and Twilight Troupe are three independent shared-unit copy families using the GS17 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance.

selectionEntries.name: Other
selectionEntries.comment: OTHER COPY-COST LEDGER. Contains all 18 pre-existing Skyweaver, Voidweaver, and Starweaver point modifiers unchanged, preserving the established 1 / 2 / 3 allowance.

catalogue.comment:
PLAYABLE HARLEQUINS ADAPTER

Harlequin unit trees are supplied by the linked Harlequins library. This catalogue owns only playable-faction presentation: which shared units appear and which primary category each uses. The library link does not import root entries automatically.

ADDITIONAL COPY COSTS
Non-Rare Other units use the soft 1/2/3 copy allowance. Skyweaver, Voidweaver, and Starweaver contribute automatic +20 Point surcharges per excess copy to the required Additional Copy Costs Configuration entry.

ERROR UX PASS V3
Additional Copy Costs duplicate validation now uses the standardized automatic_configuration_duplicate custom error. The catalogue now targets Game System revision 9 for the shared constructive Leader Capacity error and unconstrained informational Disclaimer.

REV8 NEW RECRUIT EXPORT COMPATIBILITY
Updated to Warhammer 40k Reforged Game System revision 12. All Points cost references now use New Recruit's canonical Warhammer 40,000 cost-type identifier 51b2-306e-1021-d207. No unit costs, loadouts, Configuration validation, library link targets, categories, or Additional Copy Costs arithmetic were otherwise changed.

REV9 POLISH PASS COMPANION
Companion release for Harlequins Library REV8. The main catalogue continues to expose the same shared Library units through existing entry links; the Library catalogue ID and all main-catalogue entry-link target IDs remain unchanged. No Additional Copy Costs arithmetic, availability, primary presentation categories, or main-catalogue mechanics were changed.

REV10 RETROSPECTIVE POLISH PASS COMPANION
Companion release for Harlequins Library REV9. The linked library received authoring-comment cleanup and grammar-safe Troupe host-limit error wording only. This playable adapter retains the same library link, entry-link targets, unit availability, primary presentation categories, Additional Copy Costs arithmetic, and all other mechanics.

REV11 / GS17 TROOP COPY COSTS
Updated to Game System revision 17 and adopted the unified Additional Copy Costs presentation with Troops and Other child ledgers. Light Troupe, Dark Troupe, and Twilight Troupe now use separate Troop 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowances; each further identical Troupe copy costs +20 Points. The arithmetic deliberately references the existing shared library unit IDs, matching the proven Skyweaver / Voidweaver / Starweaver Other-copy architecture. All 18 pre-existing Other point modifiers were moved unchanged to the Other child. The main catalogue continues to link the same Harlequins Library ID and entryLink IDs are unchanged. All unrelated entryLinks, primary presentation categories, Leader behavior, loadouts, and other mechanics remain unchanged.
